assert rules["missing_group"] == "block"

# Deterministic independent computation
obs=d["observations"]
# Ungrouped: group identity is null
# Missing x excluded; valid y contributes to n; null y contributes to missing.
buckets={}
for r in obs:
    x=r.get("x")
    if x is None:
        continue
    # numeric binary64
    if isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x,(int,float)) or not math.isfinite(float(x)):
        raise ValueError("Invalid numeric X")
    xf=float(x)
    buckets.setdefault(xf, []).append(r.get("y"))

# Add expected_x, if any
for x in rules.get("expected_x",[]):
    if isinstance(x,bool) or not isinstance(x,(int,float)) or not math.isfinite(float(x)):
        raise ValueError("Invalid expected numeric X")
    buckets.setdefault(float(x), [])

points=[]
for x in sorted(buckets):
    vals=buckets[x]
    valid=[]
    missing=0
    for y in vals:
        if y is None:
            missing += 1
        else:
            if isinstance(y,bool) or not isinstance(y,(int,float)) or not math.isfinite(float(y)):
                raise ValueError("Invalid Y")
            valid.append(float(y))
    if rules["aggregation"]=="unique" and len(vals)>1:
        raise ValueError("Duplicate same-group X under unique aggregation")
    yval=math.fsum(valid)/len(valid) if valid else None
    points.append({"x":float(x),"y":yval,"n":len(valid),"missing":missing})

statistics={"series":[{"group":None,"points":points}]}

def covers(font_path, text):

    return all((ch.isspace() or ord(ch) in cmap) for ch in text)

def wrap_to_pixels(text, max_px, prop, fontsize):
    words=text.split(" ")
    lines=[]
    cur=""
    for word in words:
        trial=word if not cur else cur+" "+word
        t=plt.Text(0,0,trial,fontproperties=prop,fontsize=fontsize,parse_math=False)
        t.set_figure(fig)
        w=t.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer).width
        if w <= max_px or not cur:
            cur=trial
        else:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur=word
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return "\n".join(lines)
